q: Restore a bicycle that no longer shifts properly.
detail: Inspect the gears, try adjustments, and test your repair on a short ride.

q: Investigate why a stream has fewer fish this year.
detail: Gather water samples, compare measurements, and test possible explanations.

q: Create a short animated story.
detail: Choose characters, style, sound, and pacing to make an audience feel something.

q: Help a younger student understand a difficult topic.
detail: Listen to the confusion, explain it another way, and encourage their progress.

q: Pitch a project to people who control the funding.
detail: Make a persuasive case, answer objections, and ask them to commit resources.

q: Reconcile a club budget with its receipts.
detail: Find missing entries, check totals, and keep accurate records others can trust.

q: Build raised garden beds for a community space.
detail: Measure materials, use tools safely, and turn a drawing into something people can use.

q: Trace a recurring computer-system failure.
detail: Look for patterns in logs, test a theory, and find the underlying cause.

q: Design the look of a student magazine.
detail: Experiment with layout, color, and images rather than follow one fixed template.

q: Support someone who is anxious about a major change.
detail: Ask thoughtful questions, listen patiently, and help them identify next steps.

q: Coordinate a team running a school fundraiser.
detail: Set priorities, delegate work, and take responsibility for the result.

q: Organize the schedule for a busy office.
detail: Track appointments, resolve conflicts, and make sure important details are not missed.

q: Care for animals at a shelter.
detail: Clean enclosures, follow feeding routines, and notice changes in animal behavior.

q: Analyze evidence from a historical mystery.
detail: Compare conflicting accounts, judge the evidence, and defend your explanation.

q: Develop an original stage performance.
detail: Interpret a scene, rehearse different approaches, and express an idea for an audience.

q: Teach a small group a practical skill.
detail: Adapt your explanation for different learners and check that everyone can participate.

q: Negotiate an agreement between two groups.
detail: Understand each side, propose a deal, and persuade people to accept tradeoffs.

q: Check a shipment against its order records.
detail: Follow a clear process, spot discrepancies, and document the corrections.

q: Help install a classroom sound system.
detail: Connect equipment, route cables, and check why one speaker is not working.

q: Study how a treatment affects recovery.
detail: Read research, compare outcomes, and ask what evidence would change your conclusion.

q: Reimagine an ordinary public space.
detail: Sketch an inviting environment and explore several unusual design directions.

q: Help a community member find needed services.
detail: Understand their situation, explain options, and connect them with support.

q: Start a small service business.
detail: Find customers, set a direction, and make decisions when the outcome is uncertain.

q: Maintain an accurate database for a community project.
detail: Use consistent categories, correct errors, and protect sensitive information.

q: Work outdoors on a habitat restoration project.
detail: Plant native species, maintain trails, and do physical tasks in changing weather.

q: Explain a surprising pattern in local traffic data.
detail: Work with numbers, question assumptions, and check alternative explanations.

q: Write a story with a distinctive voice.
detail: Invent characters, revise dialogue, and shape how readers experience the world.

q: Lead an activity that helps a group feel included.
detail: Notice who is left out and adapt the activity to help people connect.

q: Represent a proposal at a public meeting.
detail: Speak up, build support, and respond to difficult questions in front of others.

q: Prepare the paperwork for an event.
detail: Track permissions, deadlines, and requirements so the plan is ready to use.

q: Prepare a meal for a large school event.
detail: Handle ingredients and equipment, follow safety steps, and produce something tangible on a deadline.

q: Design an experiment to improve a product.
detail: Change one variable at a time, record results, and decide what the tests show.

q: Create a visual identity for a community project.
detail: Try original concepts, respond to feedback, and communicate through design.

q: Assist a patient learning a care routine.
detail: Explain the steps calmly, listen to concerns, and support their independence.

q: Help a customer choose between several options.
detail: Learn what matters to them and persuade them that a particular solution meets their needs.

q: Audit a set of instructions before they are published.
detail: Check every step against a standard and record anything that needs correction.
